_about: Session 1300 (chain 093): scripted model turns for the general chat, run through both loops (warehouse/chat/ask.py and site/lib/chat/ask.ts) over the rows of tests/fixtures/session1112/held_reads.json, by tests/test_session1300.py and site/scripts/test-ask-1300.mjs. Each turn is what the model returns: tool calls, or the answer as JSON text. The figures are the fixture's rows (cost_of_power_monthly, January 2026, rt_load_weighted: ERCOT's hub average 54.481, CAISO SP15 32.694), and the wrong ones are written wrong on purpose. Session 1317 added the scenario a_series, over the twelve yearly rows of ercot_peak_premium_annual recorded from the live set in tests/fixtures/session143/tool_reads.json (named under extra, read from there at run time).

scenarios.question: How has ERCOT's hub average peak premium changed year by year since 2015?

text.answer: ERCOT's hub average peak premium (the peak hour less the midday median) rose from -0.16 USD/MWh in 2015 to 13.65 USD/MWh in 2022 and 14.52 USD/MWh in 2025; 2026 so far stands at 12.29 USD/MWh (ercot_peak_premium_annual).
